intent: A kill feed in the top-left corner shows short coloured messages like 'Alice ate Bot' whenever a player or bot swallows another; each line fades out after a few seconds, so players see who is hunting whom.
accept: When one player/bot swallows another, a line naming killer and victim appears in a corner of the screen
Each line is coloured by the killer's colour (own = light blue, bots = red) and fades out within a few seconds
At most a handful of lines show at once, newest on top, and they do not overlap the minimap
In the preview after clip at least one kill-feed message is visible

criteria.text: When one player/bot swallows another, a line naming killer and victim appears in a corner of the screen
criteria.evidence: after/shot-1..3: top-left corner shows only the debug caption; no 'X ate Y' line. Diff adds detectKills/drawKillFeed in assets.ts but no test proves it fires.

criteria.text: Each line is coloured by the killer's colour (own = light blue, bots = red) and fades out within a few seconds
criteria.evidence: No line visible in any after shot; fade logic exists in drawKillFeed (config killFeedLifetime 5s) but is unproven.

criteria.text: At most a handful of lines show at once, newest on top, and they do not overlap the minimap
criteria.evidence: Code caps at killFeedMaxLines=5 and draws top-left (minimap is bottom-right), but nothing is visible in the shots to confirm.

criteria.text: In the preview after clip at least one kill-feed message is visible
criteria.evidence: after/shot-1, shot-2, shot-3 contain no kill-feed text; they look identical to before apart from entity motion.

findings: Kill feed never shows in the preview: in packages/games/template/assets.ts detectKills probably never matches real snapshots (requires victim r drop >2 AND jump >50 between snapshots; check how rules.ts respawns/shrinks the eaten player and relax or adapt the heuristic, e.g. detect respawn by position jump alone or by a size drop relative to the victim's previous size).
No tests: add packages/games/template/assets.test.ts (or similar) covering detectKills with a synthetic prev/next pair where one player eats another, and a no-kill case.
Stray formatting in onSnapshot (`const players =Object.values`) in assets.ts; tidy.

Ensure the preview scenario produces a kill within the clip (bots collide), and that the feed text is large/contrasting enough to read on a phone (fontSize 16 is small; raise killFeedFontSize in config.ts to ~22).
